bio_section.title: About Me
paragraphs: Hi! I am Sophia, a senior from Wellesley College Class of 2026, with a double major in Media Arts & Sciences and Psychology.

In a world where technology and artistry converge, I find myself driven by creativity and innovation and fascinated by interdisciplinary learning. I am exploring careers in product design/management, and user experience/user interface (UX/UI) design.

Captivated by the idea of fully exploring a world of possibilities within a project-driven space, I hope to pursue a career within the product-based technology sector, diving into the question: How might we design for empathy, usability, and equity?

individual_projects.title: Dovekie Interface
individual_projects.tagline: Open-source live-coding interface for creative expression

sections.title: Overview
body: Implemented the Dovekie (open-source live coding JS package) interface and designed key interactive components. Created p5.js sketches to experiment with dynamic, parameter-driven generative workflows.

As part of the Future Sketches group at MIT Media Lab, I contributed to the development of an open-source live-coding environment that enables creative expression through code. The project focused on creating intuitive interfaces that bridge the gap between technical complexity and artistic creativity.

items.heading: Interface Design & Implementation
items.text: Designed and implemented user interface components for the Dovekie live-coding environment, focusing on intuitive parameter manipulation and real-time feedback.

items.heading: Generative Workflows
items.text: Created p5.js sketches demonstrating dynamic, parameter-driven generative workflows that showcase the platform's creative potential.

items.heading: User Experience Enhancement
items.text: Collaborated with the development team on interface usability improvements and user experience optimization.

items.heading: Open Source Documentation
items.text: Contributed to open-source documentation and community resources to support developer adoption.

sections.title: Technical Approach
body: The interface design process involved understanding the unique needs of live-coding practitioners and translating complex technical requirements into intuitive user interactions. Key considerations included:

items.heading: Real-time Feedback
items.text: Ensuring immediate visual response to parameter changes for fluid creative workflow.

items.heading: Parameter Manipulation
items.text: Designing intuitive controls for complex parameter spaces and value ranges.

items.heading: Workflow Integration
items.text: Seamless integration with existing creative coding practices and tools.

extra.title: Impact
extra.text: Contributed to an open-source tool that enables creative live-coding experiences for artists and developers worldwide, fostering innovation in the intersection of code and creativity.

individual_projects.title: AI Art Analysis
individual_projects.tagline: Flask AI art critique app with RAG, CLIP ONNX, and API integration

sections.title: Overview
body: Developed a comprehensive Flask application that delivers real-time AI-powered art analysis, combining advanced machine learning techniques with intuitive user interface design for accessible art critique.

As a UROP under the "Future Sketches" research group, I created an innovative application that bridges the gap between AI technology and art analysis. The project demonstrates the potential of combining computer vision, natural language processing, and user-centered design to create meaningful interactions between users and AI systems in the creative domain.

items.heading: RAG Implementation
items.text: Integrated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to provide contextually relevant and informed art analysis based on extensive art historical knowledge.

items.heading: CLIP ONNX Integration
items.text: Leveraged CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) through ONNX runtime for efficient image understanding and cross-modal analysis capabilities.

items.heading: Real-time Analysis
items.text: Developed full-stack functionality enabling immediate AI-powered feedback and critique on uploaded artwork with responsive user interface.

items.heading: API Integration
items.text: Implemented robust API architecture to support seamless communication between frontend interface and AI analysis backend systems.

sections.title: Technical Implementation
body: The development process involved creating a sophisticated AI pipeline that processes visual art through multiple analytical layers. Key technical achievements included:

items.heading: Flask Backend
items.text: Architected a scalable Flask application with efficient routing and data processing capabilities.

items.heading: AI Model Integration
items.text: Successfully integrated multiple AI models including CLIP for visual analysis and language models for critique generation.

items.heading: Frontend Development
items.text: Created an intuitive user interface that makes complex AI analysis accessible to users of all technical backgrounds.

extra.title: Impact
extra.text: Demonstrated the potential of AI-assisted art analysis tools to democratize art critique and education, providing accessible insights into artistic techniques, composition, and historical context.

extra.title: Development Approach
extra.text: Utilized AI-assisted coding methodologies throughout the development process, showcasing modern collaborative approaches between human developers and AI systems.

individual_projects.title: Electronic Textiles
individual_projects.tagline: Concept Art & 3D Visualization at MIT Media Lab

sections.title: Overview
body: Concept art and 3D visualization project for sensor network applications under the supervision of Irmandy Wicaksono. Focused on device designs and user interaction within electronic textile systems.

This project explored the intersection of wearable technology and textile design, creating visual concepts that demonstrate how sensors and electronic components can be seamlessly integrated into fabric-based interfaces. The work involved both artistic visualization and technical consideration of real-world implementation constraints.

sections.title: Design Process
body: The design process involved extensive research into current wearable technology limitations and opportunities for improvement. Using tools like CLO 3D, Blender, and Photoshop, I created detailed visualizations that bridge the gap between conceptual ideas and practical implementation.

Each concept piece was developed with consideration for sensor placement, user comfort, and aesthetic integration with everyday clothing. The goal was to make electronic textiles feel natural and appealing rather than intrusive or overtly technological.

items.heading: Concept Art & Visualization
items.text: Created 20+ concept art pieces for sensor networks and device integration within wearable textile systems.

items.heading: 3D Design & Modeling
items.text: Developed detailed 3D visualizations using CLO 3D, Blender, Photoshop, to demonstrate integration possibilities.

items.heading: Algorithm Optimization
items.text: Optimized algorithms for accurate visualization of smart garment patterns and sensor placement.

items.heading: Research Collaboration
items.text: Collaborated with researchers on technical feasibility assessments and real-world implementation constraints.

items.heading: Documentation & Analysis
items.text: Documented design rationale and implementation considerations for future development reference.

extra.title: Focus Areas
extra.text: Specialized in sensor network visualization, wearable device integration, and user interaction design with careful attention to technical feasibility and aesthetic considerations.

extra.title: Impact
extra.text: Created comprehensive visual concepts that informed the development of next-generation electronic textile applications and helped researchers visualize complex integration challenges.

sections.title: What Is Vinetality?
body: Vinetality is a small, portable keychain interface that provides tangible feedback to support productivity, well-being, and community building.

Problem Statement: Students and young professionals working independently in mobile environments often struggle to balance productivity, stress, and a sense of community. Existing apps and tools provide limited emotional engagement and fail to offer meaningful feedback or connection.
Innovation: A physical, shape-changing representation of measured well-being + creative community building.

items.alt: Vinetality concept sketch showing closed plant state
items.caption: Closed State

items.alt: Vinetality concept sketch showing grown plant state
items.caption: Grown State

sections.title: Project Documentation
body: Explore the complete project documentation including process insights, user research, and technical implementation details.

items.heading: Shape-Changing Feedback
items.text: Physical plant-like interface that responds to user behavior, growing when engaging in productive activities and wilting with neglect.

items.heading: Portable Design
items.text: Compact keychain form factor with custom 3D-printed enclosure designed for everyday portability and durability.

items.heading: Smart Integration
items.text: Bluetooth connectivity with smartphone integration and mobile app for habit tracking and device configuration.

items.heading: Community Building
items.text: Social features that connect users and create accountability networks for productivity and well-being goals.

sections.title: Technical Approach
body: The design combines emotional design principles with advanced tangible interaction technologies to create meaningful behavioral feedback:

items.heading: Physical Computing
items.text: Arduino-based microcontroller with shape-memory alloys and servo motors for transformation.

items.heading: Motor Mechanics
items.text: Precise motor control systems enable smooth, lifelike plant movements that respond to user activity patterns.

items.heading: Emotional Design
items.text: Plant metaphor creates emotional investment and intuitive understanding of personal growth.

extra.title: Impact
extra.text: Created a novel approach to habit formation that combines emotional design with tangible interaction, demonstrating how physical interfaces can motivate behavioral change and foster community connections.

sections.title: Overview
body: Pre-professional networking platform specifically designed for Wellesley College students and alumni in tech and tech-adjacent fields. Built front-end and back-end entirely from scratch as a team project.

The platform addresses the unique networking challenges faced by students transitioning from academia to the technology industry, providing tailored features for pre-professional connections, mentorship opportunities, and career development within the Wellesley community.

items.heading: Authentication System
items.text: User authentication and profile management system with secure login and personalized user experiences.

items.heading: Networking Platform
items.text: Professional networking capabilities with advanced search and filtering for targeted connections.

items.heading: Database Integration
items.text: Comprehensive database integration for user data, connections, and platform interactions.

items.heading: Responsive Design
items.text: Responsive design implementation working seamlessly across all device sizes and platforms.

items.heading: Full-Stack Architecture
items.text: Complete full-stack architecture built from the ground up with modern web development practices.

extra.title: Learning Outcomes
